entities.summary: Luiza Helena Trajano Inácio Rodrigues is a Brazilian businessperson. She is chair of the retailer Magazine Luiza and associated companies. In July 2020, Forbes noted that she was Brazil's wealthiest woman. Trajano is an advisory board member to both UNICEF Brazil and UNFPA Brazil, among other entities. In 2021 Luiza was listed by TIME magazine as one of the 100 most influential people in the world. She is a feminist. Luiza Trajano was a performers & entertainers from Franca (b. 1948-10-09, Franca). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
